quote: Saharon Shelah's 1975 conjecture on the Borel monadic theory of order (BMTO)
note: The problem was first posed in Shelah's 1975 paper 'The monadic theory of order'. The conjecture remained open until 2024 when Sven Manthe proved that BMTO is decidable.
